data.narrative: Wrote an operator overview and three linear runbooks, then walked postgres-unreachable against a really-down Postgres: /live 200 in 0.052s, /ready 503 in 4.082s, Docker Desktop pipe missing. BREAK renamed the probe to /readyz so the documented /ready returned 404 in 0.008s with no checklist branch. FIX updated the docs to /readyz plus Step 2b and re-walked: /readyz 503 in 4.049s; compose was not started.

dimension_scores.observation: Named linkops-postgres and url-shortener-prod, forbade docker rm, and treated daemon-down as escalate rather than a fake start.
dimension_scores.evidence: docker ps error open //./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine; Fix step says stop if daemon is down.

dimension_scores.observation: Documented git push origin main and git revert --no-edit HEAD as deploy/rollback because CI does not ship a host.
dimension_scores.evidence: docs/service-overview.md Deploy and Rollback sections; no Railway commands.

dimension_scores.observation: Runbooks key off HighErrorRate/HighLatencyP95 and named logs, not 'check the logs'.
Separated path-drift 404 from Postgres 503, and refused to expect breaker-open 4ms after one probe.
dimension_scores.evidence: First drill READY2 503 4.073s still closed; BREAK /ready 404 0.008 {"detail":"Not Found"}; stale /ready still 404 after FIX.

dimension_scores.observation: Told on-call not to loop the readiness probe; wait reset_timeout=30; fail-closed 503; no fake URLs.
dimension_scores.evidence: postgres-unreachable.md: do not send 10 /readyz probes; /live stays 200 while /readyz 503.

dimension_scores.observation: First stranger walk produced five expected-output patches; BREAK silence at Step 2 produced Step 2b and /readyz commands with captured output.

strengths: Executed the runbook against the real down DB instead of docker stop, and pasted host-specific outputs (0.052s live, 4.082s ready, Docker pipe error).
When /ready 404'd, stopped instead of inventing a compose start, then patched the docs and re-walked top to bottom.
Kept the DECIDE checklist spine and added one PATH DRIFT branch only where the list went silent.
growth_areas: The close path (docker compose up -d postgres then /readyz 200) was never observed; Docker Desktop is down on this host.
No ServiceDown runbook for a dead process / import hang, which Step 1 still points at.
data.recommendation: Module 08 deploy verify must treat /readyz 404 as a failed health-route deploy, not as Postgres down, and must not loop /readyz while the breaker is closed (~4s per trial).
